outfit.name: 吹雪组总帅翡翠丝绒高定鱼尾礼服
outfit.prose: An architectural emerald green velvet strapless mermaid gown with structured internal boning carving out an exaggerated hourglass waist. A high front-side split reveals sheer black stockings and a dual-strap leather thigh garter with polished chrome hardware, draped with an opulent white arctic fox fur stole.
